en: Guess that's out of the way. Once I'm ready, next stop's the batting center.
Guess this is Majima's way of whippin' me into shape. Time to do my thing.
Still got time, so guess I'll see how everyone's doing.
Looks like Baba-chan could use some advice.
Guess I'm starting with some cabaret club on Lavender Street.
Where to go... Gindaco Highball Tavern, Hanako, or Matsuo Lamb Barbeque?
Imaginary battles don't feel right... Might as well make it a good fight, though.
Where'd Baba-chan get to? Better ask if anyone's seen him.
What went down in the storeroom?
Gotta find proof to clear Baba-chan's name.
So it was Kugihara who pinned this on Baba-chan.
Nobody does that to Baba-chan and gets away with it!

Part 2, Chapter 1 Complete
On to Part 2, Chapter 2
Think I'm better off doin' what he says for now. He said he'd tell me the rest in the storeroom.
So this time it's a bar on Lavender Street. I think the place was called Ambitious.
Next I have to head to Ramen Village on East Nakatsuki Street.
A mafia battle? Seriously? Ah well, guess it's all fun and games. I'll pummel 'em to pieces.
Gotta take out these guys and get through the southwest gate!
Ain't my time to bite the dust just yet. There're still things I gotta do!

Part 2, Chapter 2 Complete
On to Part 2, Chapter 3
Can't just sit here. Better go check things out.
I'll ask around if anyone can spare some food.
Sakurai-han can tell me how to get up the mountain.
I'll let Sakurai-han know when I'm ready to start searchin' for Baba-chan.
Gotta find Baba-chan quick. He better still be okay!
Better tell Okudera-han that Baba-chan is awake.
Nishina-han's wife gave me some deer meat. I'll go ask Sakurai-han if he has any hunting gear to spare.
I need a gun. Maybe Nishina-han has a spare.
No dice, huh? Guess I'd better head back to see Sakurai-han.
Ready to go hunting at last. I'll let Sakurai-han know.
Better follow the river so I don't get lost.
Gotta listen to Okudera-han and learn this stuff quick.
There's supposed to be a hunting hut out there. That's the first stop.
Gotta actually catch something first. I'll stick with Okudera-han.
I'll stay quiet and follow these tracks.
A deer. I'll crouch down and get close, then kill it before it notices me.
Better head over to the deer I killed and recover the meat.
I'll head back to the village once I get the hang of things.
Time to give Nishina-han's wife that deer meat.
I handed in my gun, so there's nothin' else to do now. I'll go see Okudera-han.
Today we're catching rabbits, he said. I'll head back to Okudera-han when I'm ready.
A trader, huh? That might help me out. Let's meet this guy.
We're hunting rabbits this time. Gotta do my best so I can get Baba-chan back on his feet quick.
I have to set snares at the trap sites.
Might as well find other sites to set traps while I wait for prey to get caught.
That oughta be enough traps for now. I'll go check on 'em in a while.
Better not try to take it on. I'll focus on scarin' it off like Okudera-han said.
Let's see if the road into town's clear yet.
Looks like the road into town is open. I'll go tell Okudera-han and Baba-chan.
Gotta tell Okudera-han once I'm ready, then head into Tsukimino quick.

Part 2, Chapter 3 Complete
On to Part 2, Chapter 4
Baba-chan knows this place better than me, so I'll follow his lead.
Baba-chan said the hideout was opposite the Don Quijote on Central Station Boulevard.
I'll try that Ambitious place first. Word is Kitakata members go there a lot.
I can't get into that casino Baba-chan told me about. What gives?
Apparently a guy at Ambitious has info on the casino.
Guess I better find that homeless guy Kiyotaka first. A place out of the wind and rain... I think there was a covered shopping area 'round somewhere.
How am I supposed to know how many homeless are here? Guess I'll ask around.
No idea how many homeless there are, but maybe some booze'll buy me info.
Gotta go find this Kiyotaka guy and get info on the casino.
Got to find the place in the photo. Guess I'll try lookin' where this phone box is.
So the password is "seven scattered losing tickets"? Guess I'll head to that lottery booth.
This oughta get me into the casino at Ambitious. I'll go try it now.
Looks like I'll have to beat the answers outta these guys!
Time to head back to Polaris and have a chat with Baba-chan.
Now's my chance to tie up any loose ends. Once I'm spent, I'll rest up at Polaris so I'm fresh for tomorrow.
Better go do some recon at Main Street Park. Gotta check out as much as I can.
Think I've seen enough. I'll make for Polaris and meet up with Baba-chan.
Tomorrow's the day of the ceremony. Gotta finish anything that needs doing, then I'll get some shut-eye at Polaris.
Time for action. I'll let Baba-chan know when I'm good to go.
Shoulda known meetin' Kitakata wouldn't be that easy. Gotta get to Baba-chan again quick.
No time to waste. Gotta take these guys out quick!
Why, Baba-chan!? Gotta catch him and get some answers!
Think it's time I taught you what livin' is all about, Baba-chan!

Part 2: Taiga Saejima complete
On to Part 3: Shun Akiyama / Haruka Sawamura
I'm not done with my lessons. I have to go see Ogita-san.
Another long day. I should go home and get ready for tomorrow.
Horie-san is waiting for me in front of the elevator. Once I'm ready, we should go back together.
The Princess League starts tomorrow. I need to get a good sleep tonight.
I have to go to the office. It's another busy day!
I'll be late to the office if I don't hurry. That dance battle was fun, though.
I'd better check today's schedule on the board in the office.
The Princess League Finals are about to begin. I should check the schedule again once I'm ready.
I'd better say hello to Manda-san, the producer. We'll be starting soon, so he should be around here somewhere.
I should head back to Sotenbori. Once I get back to the office, I have to start preparing for the next round.
I think I'll go back to the office once I'm done here. It's time to start training for the second round.
Yamaura-san is waiting. I should hurry to the studio.
Ogita-san said he'd be at the office. I should go ask about my next lesson.
It sounds like Ogita-san is in Park-san's office. I should go ask about my next lesson.
I have to find Christina!
I wonder what the next job is. I think I'll talk with Horie-san at the office and find Park-san.
Once I'm ready to go to Soten TV, I should meet up with Horie-san at the taxi stand.
I have to apologize to Manda-san for what happened today. Where could he be?
That came out of nowhere. I'd better pull myself together and go apologize to Manda-san.
It's been a tough day. I should go and rest up for tomorrow.

Part 3, Chapter 1 Complete
On to Part 3, Chapter 2
My lessons with Christina start today. I should go in to the office.
Christina is waiting for me. I have to hurry to the studio.
I've got to start my lessons. I should go and see Christina.
I have to meet up with Horie-san. He said he was out in front of Don Quijote.
I'm looking forward to going shopping with Park-san. Time to head back to the office.
I wonder if Park-san is back yet. I'll try her office.
Park-san is waiting in her office. I'll go see her once I'm ready.
I feel so lucky that I get to go shopping with Park-san like this.
Today was really fun. I should go get some sleep so I'm fresh for tomorrow.
Horie-san was really flustered. I'd better hurry to the office!

Part 3, Chapter 2 Complete
On to Part 3, Chapter 3
This is the last thing I need right now. Oh well, guess I have to get this over with.
Park-san committed suicide!? I can't believe it... I have to get over to Dyna Chair quick.
So the new girl here was the last to see her. The studio was on the fourth floor if I remember right.
Let's start by checking the roof. There could be a clue there.
I've got time on my hands, so I should get anything else I wanted to do out of the way.
I'm free for a little while, so it's a good time to get some stuff done.
Haruka-chan is waiting. I'd better head to Dyna Chair.
Akiyama-san is waiting. I should go into the office.
I guess Park-san's office is the best place to look for a note, huh?
Huh? I'd better check the emergency exit.
What's this guy done to Horie-chan!? Looks like I'll have to beat some answers out of him.
Damn, this guy's a monster. But I don't plan on giving up just yet.

Part 3, Chapter 3 Complete
On to Part 3, Chapter 4
It's the Princess League today. Once I'm ready, I'll check in with the office.
Looks like I have some time to myself. Once I run out of things to do, I guess I'll go see how Haruka-chan is doing.
When I'm ready, I'll talk to Yamaura-san and go to the second round of the Princess League.
Akiyama-san is waiting for me outside the office. He said he had something to tell Yamaura-san and me. I wonder what it could be?
The Crest Bar is in Hoganji Yokocho. I'll go check it out.
I get the feeling they know something. I'll wait and see what they do.
I guess I'll head to the Shofukucho parking lot. I'd better be on my guard.
Looks like I'll have to apply some pressure to get answers here. Oh well, here goes.
Akiyama-san said he'd be waiting at the Crest Bar in Hoganji Yokocho.
Tomorrow is the final round of the Princess League. I have to make sure I get a good sleep tonight.
I guess I'll see what I can dredge up at Osaka Talent tomorrow. I'll stay at Sky Finance tonight.
Okay, time to pay Osaka Talent a visit. I guess I'll need a taxi.
Yamaura-san is waiting at the studio. I have to train for the final round.
Time to check in with Yamaura-san at the office, then head to the final round of the Princess League!
Who was that guy on the phone? He said he'd be waiting at Sky Finance.
Perfect timing. Let's get some info on Ousaka Enterprises!
I guess I'll take a taxi to Ousaka Enterprises. I'd better make sure I'm ready. You can't be too careful.
I'm not letting up until I get answers out of that Kanai!
Damn it! So now they've dragged Haruka-chan into this. I have to fight my way through!
I've got to help Haruka-chan! I'd better see what's up at Dyna Chair before I go anywhere, though.
If she went to Shin-Osaka Station, she must have taken a taxi. I'll ask around at the taxi stands.
It looks like she did head to Shin-Osaka Station. I'd better get ready and take a taxi there, too.
This looks pretty grim. But if that guy thinks he can get away with this, he's got another thing coming!

Part 3: Shun Akiyama / Haruka Sawamura complete
On to Part 4: Tatsuo Shinada
Damn, I'm late for my interview! I'd better head to Club Futo Momo now. It's on Icho Street, so it's a bit of a walk.
Sounds like Milky-chan's brother is in a jam. I guess I'll check out Kubota Security on the corner of Icho Street.
No need to hold back with these guys. They're getting what's coming to them.
I can finally get back to that interview. Time to head back to Club Futo Momo.
That wraps up my article on Milky-chan. Now I just have to get it in to the publisher.
I guess the batting center's my only hope now.
What's with this guy? Oh well, it's probably easier to shut him up than talk him down.
Anyway, the batting center's still my only hope.
Damn... There goes my money. Well, no point standing around.
I need to get to Ushijima-san's place on Kumano Boulevard. I can smell the miso stew already.
Today was a bummer. I guess I'll head home.
Is he seriously still going on about that time at bat? Guess I gotta make this quick.

Part 4, Chapter 1 Complete
On to Part 4, Chapter 2
Geez, I'd rather just forget about the past. I need to go out and get my mind off this.
Someday I'll beat Shirakawa... For now, I just need to go out and get my mind off things.
I've still got Coach Igarashi's training. I'll head to the bar once I finish my fishing. I guess I'll keep looking around town for now.
Fujita-san is the new manager for the Gigants? I'd better check the TV and see if it's true.
Damn it. Today has been the worst.
Milky-chan said she'd be waiting for me on the roof of Club Futo Momo.
I'd better get back to reality, too. Time to head home.
The folks at Nightlife Magazine have something for me. I might as well head there now.
I'm exhausted. I need to go home and sleep.
Uno-san would know about what happened back then, and his place isn't that far. It's the Uno Acupuncture Clinic on Obiita Street.
